🎥🎬: Death Becomes Her (1992)

Madeline Ashton and Helen Sharp have been bitter rivals for years, both connected to the same man, Ernest. When Helen suddenly returns looking impossibly young and beautiful, Madeline becomes desperate to discover her secret.

She soon meets the mysterious Lisle von Rhuman, who offers her a magical potion promising eternal youth. Madeline takes it, only to discover that immortality doesn’t mean she can’t be injured. When Helen gets the same treatment, their old rivalry turns into an outrageous battle where neither woman can actually die.

With Ernest caught between them, the feud spirals into a darkly hilarious struggle involving jealousy, vanity, revenge, and increasingly bizarre attempts to destroy one another.
